description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Backup' within the OpenCart admin system, responsible for managing database backup tasks including scheduling and writing backup data.

classes.name: Backup
classes.description: A controller class for managing database backup tasks in the OpenCart admin system, providing functionalities to initiate backups and write backup data to files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of backup tasks based on provided arguments, scheduling tasks for each database table to be backed up in segments.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Handles the actual backup data writing process, exporting table data into SQL insert statements and writing to a backup file.
